tuning.note: The entities' numbers (docs/23a, D9; src/tuning.js has each one's meaning). These are the values the code carried until 2026-10-12, the cozy parent's for the most part, never re-decided: docs/02 question 19 is answered by editing this file. A section or a key left out keeps its default.

water.note: Unsafe water (Michael, 2026-10-19, #279): every natural source, water tiles and wells, is unsafe until purified, and its Drink says "(tainted)" (Michael, 2026-10-19). `clean` lists the sprites of sources that are safe (none yet; how water is purified is open); a waterskin's water is tainted unless its entry is marked `clean`.

stagger.note: a hit staggers the dead one with the weapon's staggerChance (this is the default); after a stagger ends it cannot be staggered again for immunity seconds; a bite under way is not cancelled unless the weapon interrupts (docs/02 question 29b)

bleed.note: a landed bite opens a wound with this chance, one more stack each (to max); the wound drains dpsByStacks[stacks - 1] a second, the timer is refreshed by each new bite and runs out by itself after duration seconds; a bandage stops it. Michael's bounds: five fresh stacks kill from full health in 10 s (not under 8 to 10 s), and one stack is a nuisance (under 5 health in all)

burn.note: burning (#14, Michael 2026-10-15): like bleeding but capped at one; a body burning loses dps a second for duration seconds, a new source refreshing the timer and never stacking, and never more than cap over one burn however often refreshed (Michael: never more than 10 against 100). Only the dead burn, never a player. Sources: a weapon's `ignite` chance (the torch's 0.25 in data/items.json), the fireball and a fire arrow always (their `ignite`)

infection.note: a landed bite infects with this chance; the moodle goes green, yellow, orange, red over this many in-game days; it does nothing else yet (docs/02 question 29b)

combo.note: the third hit on one dead one within `window` seconds always floors it; switched off for testing (Michael, 2026-10-12), the code kept

finisher.note: what a blow on a downed dead one is multiplied by (was 2)

dual.note: an off-hand swing leaves you exposed for `window` seconds: a blow takes `front` times its damage from the front arc, `side` times from the sides, `behind` times (fatal) from behind; `lockout` is the share of a swing before the other hand may swing; `offDamage` multiplies the off hand's blows (1 = full; World of Warcraft's flat penalty would be 0.5) (docs/21)

blow.note: pointBlank: tiles this close are always hit; knockdownChance: the share of hits that floor the dead for a weapon with no knockdown of its own (high; for the combat pass, Michael 2026-10-15); tiredDamage: a swing at zero stamina lands at this share; hitStop, hitStopKill: seconds the world freezes on a hit and on a kill

bow.note: the fireball as a flare (#156, Michael 2026-10-17): fireballGlow its light in flight, flareRadius and flareSeconds the light where it lands (light only), kindleRadius how near it lights a campfire or mounted torch; the bow's draw and every arrow's and thrown thing's flight (archery.js tunables; a bow's own drawTime, braceDrawTime, damage, and a thrown block override them): range and speed in tiles, heights in px; drawSpeed and braceMove the walk while drawing and braced; recoverTime the pause after a shot

looks.note: The character screen's palettes (docs/12, the creation screen; docs/31/03, the identity). The skin ramp is the design agent's, approved by Michael 2026-10-12 (data/art/character/character_body.json): eight living tones pale to deep, three dead ones (grey-green, grey, bruised blue) allowed in the creator for fun (Michael, 2026-10-13). The shadow is the engine's own rule (tone * 0.84). Hair and eye colours are first picks, Michael's to change here; a painted hair with no dye option (purple) keeps its own colours.

stages.name: Bitten
stages.text: The bite broke the skin. You feel fine. Watch it.

stages.name: Fevered
stages.text: A chill and a headache. It is spreading.

stages.name: Sick
stages.text: Your hands shake. There is not much time.

stages.name: Turning
stages.text: It has taken hold. (Nothing happens yet: a marker.)

stages.name: Hungry
stages.text: Your stomach is making itself heard.

stages.name: Very hungry
stages.text: Hard to think about anything but food.

stages.name: Starving
stages.text: You are wasting away. Eat something.

stages.name: Parched
stages.text: Hard to catch your breath. Stamina recovers slowly.

stages.name: Dying of thirst
stages.text: You will not last long without water.
